insights: Model scaling alone (ELECTRA-small → ELECTRA-base) improved adversarial robustness by 14.91%
Adversarial training with ELECTRA-small showed a trade-off: +9.49% adversarial, -11.56% clean
Adversarial training with ELECTRA-base eliminated the trade-off: +17.22% adversarial, +2.46% clean
ELECTRA-base 80-20 original achieved 88.43% EM on adversarial data
Data augmentation slightly reduced performance for ELECTRA-base (88.43% → 86.12%)
Model capacity is critical for effective adversarial training without performance trade-offs
Negation-Aware training achieved NEW BEST: 88.93% EM on AddSent, 90.07% EM on SQuAD
Targeted mitigation (negation-aware) improved both adversarial (+0.50%) and clean (+0.10%) performance
3x loss weighting for negation examples effectively reduced negation confusion errors
